ReviewedInteractions.Rationale: The changed unit transition callback derives player ID through GetOwner at the same owned hook; release mod call-site hooks do not patch this function entry.
Only the missing-scan warning text changed; no executable hook bytes or target changed.
Existing call-site adapters consume the extender-owned result at RVA 0x196870 and preserve a positive result.
The inline site at RVA 0x704CC remains in the original trampoline of the extender hook at RVA 0x6FE90.
Fixes AIV relocation hooks operate on ordered-map-tile buffer sites; our release native hooks do not write those sites. Its save/load copy issue is documented separately.
